therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PI3K inhibition combined with VEGF pathway blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Dual inhibition of tumor cell survival/proliferation and angiogenesis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with refractory solid tumors and relapsed/refractory glioblastoma multiforme
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Dose-limiting toxicity determination (Phase I) and progression-free survival (Phase II)

results.effect_size: PFS 5.3 months (95% CI: 3.6–9.2) in bevacizumab-naive patients; PFS 2.8 months (95% CI: 1.6–5.3) in prior bevacizumab patients
subgroup_findings: Bevacizumab-naive patients had longer PFS (5.3 vs 2.8 months)
Overall response rate: 18/76 (23.7%) in bevacizumab-naive vs 1/76 (1.3%) in prior bevacizumab patients
Median OS: 10.8 months (95% CI: 9.2–13.5) in bevacizumab-naive vs 6.6 months (95% CI: 4.0–14.6) in prior bevacizumab patients
safety_signals: Serious psychiatric events including psychosis and suicidal ideation
results.dose_information: BKM120 60 mg PO daily + Bevacizumab 10 mg/kg IV every 2 weeks (28-day cycles). 80 mg BKM120 dose level had 3 DLTs and was not tolerable.

context.duration: Treatment until progression, up to 33 months follow-up for PFS
